_meta.status: documented-behavior fixture; replaces live wire until budget approved
notes: Explicit caching via cache_control breakpoints (up to 4 per request).
TTL 5 min default, 1 h option; TTL refreshes FREE on every cache hit.
Write premium: 1.25x base for 5-min entries, 2x base for 1-h entries; reads 0.1x.
Min cacheable prefix: 1024 tokens on Sonnet/Opus (Haiku tiers are 2048/4096 - not modeled here).
Hit requires exact prefix match up to the breakpoint (all-or-nothing), modeled as match_mode=breakpoint.

latency_model._comment: synthetic-but-plausible; only latency RATIOS (hit vs miss) matter for verdicts
